issue.title: Progressive first-login sync: unblock Home before full catalogue + bible-text pull
issue.body:
## Summary / context

Cold (first) login runs a **full** `syncAllData(false)` and keeps Home behind a full-screen **"Syncing data…"** spinner (`postLoginSyncActive`) until **everything** finishes — master catalogues, projects, **all** chapter assignments, and bible texts for every synced chapter.

That is too slow for an offline-first app used on poor networks. Warm Sync Now was improved by [#612](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/612) (incremental master data + single-flight), but a **first empty DB** still pays the full catalogue + large assignment/text pull once. Device evidence in [#483](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/483): ~600+ `chapter_assignments` / ~19k+ `bible_texts` after first sync.

Prepare for Offline already owns bulk offline packs (audio/resources). Login should not duplicate a "download the world" job.

## Current behavior

1. Login → `AuthSessionProvider.signIn` sets `postLoginSyncActive` and starts `syncAllData(false)`.
2. Home (`HomeScreen`) blocks on `postLoginSyncActive` with "Syncing data…".
3. Login path (empty local projects) roughly:
   - `syncUser`
   - claims + **full** `syncMasterData` (no cursor → ~7.6k languages + books + bibles; audit ~30s on Wi‑Fi alone)
   - `syncPericopeSets` → projects → milestones
   - **full** `syncChapterAssignments` + `syncUserChapterWork`
   - `syncPericopes` → `syncBibleTexts` for **all** chapters from `getChaptersToSync()` (`SELECT DISTINCT … FROM chapter_assignments`)

## Expected behavior

**Tiered post-login sync** — Home becomes usable after a small critical path; heavy work continues in the background or via Prepare for Offline.

### Tier 1 — "Can see My Work" (only this may block the Home full-screen spinner)

- User + projects + milestones
- **User chapter work only** (assigned + peer-check) — not the full project assignment catalogue when the DB is empty
- Bible texts **only for those My Work chapters**
- Target: seconds on mediocre networks, not minutes

### Tier 2 — Background after Home is interactive

- Remaining assignments / master data / other bible texts as needed for Projects browse
- Non-blocking chrome (header sync icon / Sync page); single-flight preserved
- Prefer on-demand or Prepare for Offline for non–My Work verse text on poor networks

### Tier 3 — Explicit offline prep (existing)

- Audio, Aquifer resources, large media → **Prepare for Offline only** — never on login

### UX rules

1. Home must not full-screen-block on Tier 2/3.
2. Record/Bible must handle missing `bible_texts` honestly — land / link [#448](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/448) (no infinite "still syncing" when sync settled).
3. Sync status distinguishes bootstrap metadata done vs verse text still downloading vs offline pack incomplete.
4. Keep single-flight so overlapping login/Sync Now cannot 429.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] After cold login on a cleared install, Home (My Work) is interactive after Tier 1 without waiting for full master catalogue + all project assignments + all bible texts
- [ ] Tier 1 pulls bible texts only for the user's assigned / peer-check chapters
- [ ] Remaining sync runs in background (or on explicit Sync Now / chapter open / Prepare for Offline) without a full-screen Home block
- [ ] Missing verse text after Tier 1 uses honest copy (see #448) — not "still syncing" when the critical path finished
- [ ] Single-flight still prevents overlapping full syncs (login + Sync Now)
- [ ] Device QA on constrained bandwidth: measure time-to-Home and approximate data transferred vs current `main`
- [ ] Unit tests cover phased login orchestration / scoped chapter set for bible-text sync

## Suggested approach

1. Split login orchestration in `src/services/sync.ts`: critical path vs background (clear `postLoginSyncActive` after Tier 1 only).
2. Scope bible-text sync for login to My Work chapters; keep broader pulls for Sync Now / repair only if product still wants that.
3. Do not gate Tier 1 on the full world languages/bibles catalogue — narrow bible/book rows needed for FKs first; rest in background (API follow-up: project-scoped or seedable master data — extends [fluent-api#373](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-api/issues/373)).
4. Keep bulk media on Prepare for Offline (#529 / #51).

## File pointers

| File | Notes |
|------|-------|
| `src/navigation/AuthSessionProvider.tsx` | `postLoginSyncActive` + `syncAllData(false)` |
| `src/app/screens/HomeScreen.tsx` | Full-screen loader while `postLoginSyncActive` |
| `src/services/sync.ts` | Login path in `syncAllData` |
| `src/db/repository.ts` | `getChaptersToSync()` — all `chapter_assignments` |

## Related

- [#612](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/612) — incremental master data / single-flight (warm Sync Now; does **not** fix first empty DB)
- [fluent-api#373](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-api/issues/373) — `updatedAfter` for master catalogues
- [#483](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/483) — Projects disk I/O after huge first sync (symptom of payload size)
- [#448](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/448) — Record messaging when source text missing after sync
- [#438](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/438) / [#587](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/587) — bandwidth-first pericopes pattern
- [#529](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/529) — Going offline / Prepare for Offline (Tier 3 home)
- [#533](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/533) — Offline chapter assignment audit (source of #612)

## Board

[Fluent Mobile Board (Project 4, view 9)](https://github.com/orgs/eten-tech-foundation/projects/4/views/9)

## Out of scope

- Upload / reconnect audits (#530, #599–#605, #611)
- Download-queue UI (#147)
- Stage advancement queue (#257)
- Implementing child tickets until this epic is shaped by product (this issue can be the parent; split Tier 1 / Tier 2 / API if needed)

comments.body: **AC waiver (ticket-level):** “Do not gate Tier 1 on the full world languages/bibles catalogue” remains unmet until API-scoped master data exists. Tracked in follow-up [#679](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/679) (depends on fluent-api#373). Mobile progressive login PR still unblocks Home after My Work assignments + My Work bible texts while Tier 2 pulls the full assignment catalogue.
